mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_account (connected_institution_id, loan_name, account_display, loan_balance, raw_response) VALUES (#{connectedInstitutionId}, #{loanName}, #{accountDisplay}, #{loanBalance}, #{rawResponse})

INSERT INTO loan_account (connected_institution_id, loan_name, account_display, loan_balance, start_date, end_date, raw_response) VALUES
(#{l.connectedInstitutionId}, #{l.loanName}, #{l.accountDisplay}, #{l.loanBalance}, #{l.startDate}, #{l.endDate}, #{l.rawResponse})
mapper.select: SELECT id, connected_institution_id, loan_name, account_display, loan_balance, raw_response, created_at, updated_at FROM loan_account WHERE connected_institution_id = #{connectedInstitutionId}

SELECT la.id, i.name AS institution_name, la.loan_name, la.account_display, la.loan_balance FROM loan_account la JOIN connected_institution ci ON la.connected_institution_id = ci.id JOIN connected_account ca ON ci.connected_account_id = ca.id JOIN institution i ON ci.institution_code = i.code WHERE ca.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY i.name

SELECT i.name AS institution_name, la.loan_name, la.account_display, la.loan_balance, la.start_date, la.end_date FROM loan_account la JOIN connected_institution ci ON la.connected_institution_id = ci.id JOIN connected_account ca ON ci.connected_account_id = ca.id JOIN institution i ON ci.institution_code = i.code WHERE ca.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY i.name

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(la.loan_balance), 0) FROM loan_account la JOIN connected_institution ci ON la.connected_institution_id = ci.id JOIN connected_account ca ON ci.connected_account_id = ca.id WHERE ca.member_id = #{memberId}
